selection_method: Fifty identities were selected before any company answer was inspected. Eight initial cases were expanded by 24 funding and 18 lifecycle cases following the user request for sample size and prospective difficulty. Reference collection used ordinary web search and primary sources, independently of Keenable and blind to evaluated outputs. This is a purposive, technology-heavy exploratory sample, not a representative benchmark.

evaluation_contract.model_inputs: Provide only company_name, input_domain, as_of and the shared task instructions. Keep expected facts and source URLs out of both arms' prompts.
arms: same Claygent configuration with Keenable retrieval available
evaluation_contract.latest_event_caveat: The supplied events are verified positive facts. Absence of a later event from this bounded review does not prove that none exists. Accept a later, correctly dated event supported by a primary source published on or before the cutoff and adjudicate it before scoring.
evaluation_contract.unknown_policy: Do not replace missing amounts, closing dates or ownership evidence with guesses. An undated page has publication_date null and a separate accessed_at date.
evaluation_contract.funding_score_scope: Score disclosed positive funding facts for 28 funding cases; current lifecycle facts for 21 acquired/public cases. Freeman is a separate entity-resolution probe. Unknown reference values are not negative facts and are not scored as required abstentions.
evaluation_contract.icp_rule: For a hypothetical independent privately held VC-backed ICP, completed acquisition and public listing are exclusions. A proposed or terminated transaction alone does not establish acquired status.
evaluation_contract.claim_limit: No claim of Keenable benefit or persistent Clay failure follows from this dataset. Such claims require actual paired runs and source adjudication.
